model.positionCountNote: A position is one R15 BACK or LAY action in WIN or PLACE. A single race can contain more than one position, so 1,071 positions/year does not mean 1,071 separate races or 1,071 verified live accepted bookmaker bets.

validationProxy.periodNote: 2019–2025 proxy history was positive in every completed year; 2026 partial was also positive in the research package.

execution.backRouting: Best accepted positive-net-EV fixed quote or Exchange

caveats: Historical PLACE execution prices and liquidity are synthetic proxies rather than actual Betfair order books.
The validation-proxy profit figures are not a forward income forecast and should not be treated as guaranteed cash.
Actual timestamped executable prices, available volume, accepted stakes and fills are required before a live R15 position is valid.
Bookmakers may limit or decline bets. Risk must never be duplicated across venues.
No system can guarantee a profitable year.
